name: 23455 · Virginia Bch, VA
findings: ZIP 23455 (Virginia Bch) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23455 (Virginia Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
